method.split: FIT 2026-11-10 00:00-12:00 UTC, TEST 12:00-24:00 UTC; robustness: TEST without 13:00-16:00 (CPI 13:30)
method.book: sim/book.py: ob200 snapshot + deltas rebuilt per message; state at the end of each 100 ms bin of the push ts; depth = notional within x bp of mid
method.ms5_y: log RV over (T, T+h], h = 5, 15 min, sum of squared 1 s mid log returns; zero RV floored at the symbol's 1st percentile of positive values
method.ms5_x: log time-averaged relative spread (bp) over the minute ending at T; robustness: spread level in bp
method.ms5_controls: log RV last 5 min, log RV last 60 min, log(depth_bid_10 + depth_ask_10) averaged over the last minute, log hour-of-week factor (profile_asof 2026-11-10 00:00, u = r^2 / trailing-168h mean r^2 on 1h last bars; pooled crypto-major profile for symbols with < 8 weeks of bars)
method.ms5_model: pooled OLS, symbol fixed effects, CR1 SE clustered by 5-minute calendar block (robustness: 30-minute blocks); OOS R^2 gain of the FIT model on TEST; Diebold-Mariano t on 5-minute block sums of the squared-error differential
method.ms6_prices: trade-time log price = per-ms VWAP (trades_raw stores no within-ms order); 1 s and 5 s grids = last trade price at or before the grid time
method.ms6_hy: Hayashi-Yoshida rho(l) = corr(leader at t, target at t+l), lags 0, +-0.1..60 s (37); peak = argmax rho; positive peak = peak in [0.1, 30] s; 5-minute block bootstrap B = 1000 of HY contributions (peak-lag distribution, LLR = sum_{l>0} rho^2 / sum_{l<0} rho^2, p = P*(LLR <= 1))
method.ms6_granger: bivariate VAR on 1 s last-trade log returns, BIC lag <= 10; HC0-robust Wald F of the other series' lags (classical F reported too), both directions
method.ms6_dy: VAR (BIC lag <= 4) on log 1 m RV (12 x 5 s returns), generalized FEVD (Pesaran-Shin) H = 10, row-normalised; net = to - from (percent); 30-minute moving-block bootstrap B = 500 with the lag fixed
method.ms6_universe: crypto = the 51-symbol trades set minus TradFi (sim.flow_data.asset_class); DY set = BTC, ETH, SOL + crypto with nonzero 1 m RV in >= 98% of TEST minutes, top by trade count, at most 15
method.verdict_ms5: supports = TEST coefficient > 0 with t > 2 and OOS R^2 gain > 0, both horizons; contradicts = coefficient <= 0 or gain <= 0 at a horizon with the one-sided p of the opposite > 0.95 (clearly wrong sign); else inconclusive
method.verdict_ms6: supports = share of crypto targets with a positive peak > 0.70 for ETH and SOL and both DY net > 0 on TEST; contradicts = a share <= 0.50 or a net CI entirely below 0; else inconclusive
method.holm: Holm over H-MS5, H-MS6; p(H-MS5) = max over horizons of the one-sided coefficient p and the DM p; p(H-MS6) = max over ETH, SOL of the binomial p (positive peaks vs 0.5) and the bootstrap P*(net <= 0)

elasticity_spread_on_rv.note: log 1m TWA spread on log same-minute RV of 1 s mid returns; spread ~ RV^coef (vol^(2 coef))
